primitives.name: Retry Budget Control
primitives.verbatim_quote: Eligible data reads accept `retries`, an integer from 0 through 5, defaulting to 2.
primitives.assumptions: Each retry consumes a unit of budget; zero retries imply single attempt.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When retries exceed limit, operation fails with RequestAbortedError.

layer2.mapping: Models exponential backoff and retry exhaustion using discrete-time stochastic processes.
layer2.telemetry: Number of retry attempts per request, success/failure ratio.

primitives.name: Request Timeout Handling
primitives.verbatim_quote: `timeout` is milliseconds until each HTTP attempt receives response headers, or `false` to disable the timeout.
primitives.assumptions: Timeout applies per HTTP attempt, not cumulative over retries.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Exceeding timeout results in rejection with RequestAbortedError.

layer2.mapping: Encodes temporal reliability constraints via bounded execution time.
layer2.telemetry: Average latency per attempt, timeout frequency.

primitives.name: Cancellation Signal Protocol
primitives.verbatim_quote: HTTP reads accept an optional final `{ signal, retries, timeout }` argument.
primitives.assumptions: Signal propagation halts ongoing requests and retries.

layer2.mapping: Maps to interrupt-driven state machines in GSE for graceful shutdowns.
layer2.telemetry: Signal activation count, abort resolution time.
